fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Jordan requires your passport to expire at least 6 months after the date you arrive.
entry.es: Jordania exige que tu pasaporte venza al menos 6 meses después de la fecha de llegada.
entry.quote: To enter Jordan, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: A single-entry visit visa can be bought on arrival at a Jordanian airport or the Sheikh Hussein/North Border land crossing.
entry.es: Se puede comprar una visa de visita de entrada única al llegar a un aeropuerto jordano o al cruce terrestre de Sheikh Hussein/frontera norte.
entry.quote: You can buy a single-entry visit visa when you arrive at a Jordanian airport or the Sheikh Hussein/North Border land crossing.

entry.en: A Jordan Pass costs 70 to 80 Jordanian dinars, includes the visa fee and gives discounted entry to major tourist sites.
entry.es: El Jordan Pass cuesta entre 70 y 80 dinares jordanos, incluye la tarifa de visa y da descuentos en los principales sitios turísticos.
entry.quote: A Jordan Pass costs between 70 and 80 Jordanian dinars, which includes the visa fee and gives discounted entry to major tourist sites.

entry.en: A departure tax of 10 Jordanian dinars must be paid in cash at all land border crossings.
entry.es: En todos los cruces fronterizos terrestres hay que pagar en efectivo una tasa de salida de 10 dinares jordanos.
entry.quote: You must pay a departure tax of 10 Jordanian dinars in cash at all land border crossings.

entry.en: An HIV test is required if you stay in Jordan for more than 30 days.
entry.es: Se exige una prueba de VIH si te quedas en Jordania más de 30 días.
entry.quote: You must have a HIV test if you are staying in Jordan for more than 30 days.

entry.en: Approval to bring a drone into Jordan must be requested at least 10 working days before travel.
entry.es: Para llevar un dron a Jordania hay que solicitar aprobación al menos 10 días hábiles antes del viaje.
entry.quote: You must apply for approval to take a drone into Jordan at least 10 working days before you travel.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all travel within 3km of the Jordan-Syria border.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a menos de 3 km de la frontera con Siria.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel to within 3km of the border with Syria.

safety.en: Crime is generally low, but there is a risk of pickpocketing, bag-snatching and theft from cars.
safety.es: La delincuencia es generalmente baja, pero existe riesgo de carterismo, robo de bolsos y robo en vehículos.
safety.quote: Crime levels are generally low, but there is a risk of pickpocketing, bag-snatching and theft from cars.

safety.en: There is a risk of flash floods in Jordan's wadis during the rainy season from November to March.
safety.es: Hay riesgo de inundaciones repentinas en los wadis durante la temporada de lluvias, de noviembre a marzo.
safety.quote: During the rainy season from November to March there’s a risk of flash floods.

safety.en: Petra Archaeological Park has strict opening hours, and being in the park outside them risks arrest and prosecution.
safety.es: El Parque Arqueológico de Petra tiene horarios estrictos y estar dentro fuera de ellos conlleva riesgo de arresto y juicio.
safety.quote: The Petra Archaeological Park has strict visitor opening and closing hours. You risk arrest and prosecution if you are in the park outside of these hours.

safety.en: The FCDO says Uber or Careem are safer than yellow taxis.
safety.es: El FCDO indica que Uber o Careem son más seguros que los taxis amarillos.
safety.quote: use Uber or Careem which are safer than yellow taxis

safety.en: Drinking alcohol on the street is illegal, but it is allowed in bars, clubs, hotels and private homes.
safety.es: Beber alcohol en la calle es ilegal, pero se permite en bares, clubes, hoteles y casas particulares.
safety.quote: It’s illegal to drink alcohol on the street, but you can drink in bars, clubs, hotels and private homes.

health.en: Medical facilities outside Amman and Aqaba are basic, so emergency treatment should be sought in those cities.
health.es: Los centros médicos fuera de Amán y Aqaba son básicos, por lo que en una emergencia conviene buscar atención allí.
health.quote: Medical facilities outside Amman and Aqaba are basic. In an emergency you should seek treatment in Amman or Aqaba.

health.en: For an ambulance in Jordan, call 911.
health.es: Para una ambulancia en Jordania, llama al 911.
health.quote: Call 911 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: Tap water is said to be potable in some areas, but bottled water is the safest choice for visitors.
health.es: Se dice que el agua del grifo es potable al menos en algunas zonas, pero el agua embotellada es la opción más segura para los visitantes.
health.quote: Tap water is said to be potable, at least in some areas, but most people drink bottled water, which is the safest choice for visitors.

health.en: Rabies is endemic in Jordan, and prompt post-exposure prophylaxis after an animal bite is recommended.
health.es: La rabia es endémica en Jordania y se recomienda buscar rápido profilaxis posexposición tras una mordedura de animal.
health.quote: Rabies is endemic in Jordan, and promptly seeking post-exposure prophylaxis after an animal bite is recommended.

health.en: The text says the biggest health risk in Jordan is being in a road traffic accident.
health.es: El texto señala que el mayor riesgo para la salud en Jordania es sufrir un accidente de tráfico.
health.quote: The biggest risk to your health in Jordan is being involved in a road traffic accident.

help.en: The emergency number in Jordan for ambulance, fire and police is 911.
help.es: El número de emergencias en Jordania para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 911.

getting_in.en: Queen Alia International Airport is Jordan's main airport, 35 km south of Amman.
getting_in.es: El Aeropuerto Internacional Queen Alia es el principal del país, a 35 km al sur de Amán.
getting_in.quote: Queen Alia International Airport. This is the country's main airport. It is 35 km (22 mi) south of Amman

getting_in.en: A free one-month ASEZA visa can be received on arrival at Aqaba, including by land.
getting_in.es: Se puede recibir una visa ASEZA gratuita de un mes al llegar a Aqaba, incluso por tierra.
getting_in.quote: You can receive a free, one-month ASEZA visa if you arrive at Aqaba (aka Aqaba Economic Zone) by land

getting_in.en: From Nuweiba in Egypt there are two services to Aqaba, a ferry and a speedboat.
getting_in.es: Desde Nuweiba, en Egipto, hay dos servicios hacia Aqaba: ferri y lancha rápida.
getting_in.quote: There are two services, ferry and speedboat.

getting_around.en: Regular taxis are abundant, bright yellow and generally in good condition, and a 10 km trip should cost around 2 JD.
getting_around.es: Los taxis comunes abundan, son amarillos y suelen estar en buen estado; un viaje de 10 km debería costar unos 2 JD.
getting_around.quote: Regular taxis are abundant in most cities. They are bright yellow and are generally in good condition. A 10 km trip should cost around 2 JD.

getting_around.en: All yellow taxis should be metered, but most drivers outside Amman do not use the meter.
getting_around.es: Todos los taxis amarillos deberían tener taxímetro, pero la mayoría de los conductores fuera de Amán no lo usan.
getting_around.quote: All yellow taxis should be metered, however most drivers outside Amman do not use them.

getting_around.en: Servees (service taxis) only leave when full, so there is no set timetable.
getting_around.es: Los servees (taxis colectivos) solo salen cuando se llenan, por lo que no hay horario fijo.
getting_around.quote: Servees only leave when full so there is no set timetable.

getting_around.en: The text advises avoiding driving outside Amman after dark.
getting_around.es: El texto aconseja evitar conducir fuera de Amán después del anochecer.
getting_around.quote: Avoid driving outside the capital, Amman, after dark.

getting_around.en: Fuel prices in Jordan are fixed by the government.
getting_around.es: Los precios del combustible en Jordania los fija el gobierno.
getting_around.quote: Fuel prices are all fixed by the government

money.en: The currency is the Jordanian dinar, written "JD" before or after the amount.
money.es: La moneda es el dinar jordano, escrito "JD" antes o después del importe.
money.quote: The currency is the Jordanian dinar, locally denoted by the symbol "JD" before or after the amount

money.en: Cards are accepted in a limited and seemingly random way.
money.es: Las tarjetas se aceptan de forma limitada y aparentemente aleatoria.
money.quote: Cards are accepted in a limited (and seemingly random) way.

money.en: ATMs are common but might charge a fee of up to 7 JD.
money.es: Los cajeros son comunes, pero pueden cobrar una comisión de hasta 7 JD.
money.quote: ATMs are commonly available, but might charge a fee of up to 7 JD

money.en: Non-Jordanians can get a VAT refund at the airport when returning home if the VAT amount is more than 50 JD.
money.es: Los no jordanos pueden obtener la devolución del IVA en el aeropuerto al volver a casa si el monto supera los 50 JD.
money.quote: Non-Jordanians can get a VAT refund at the airport when they are returning home. The VAT amount must be more than 50 JD

money.en: Many places have limited change, so it is important to keep 1 JD and 5 JD notes.
money.es: Muchos lugares tienen poco cambio, por lo que conviene llevar billetes de 1 y 5 JD.
money.quote: Many places have limited change so it is important to keep a quantity of 1 JD and 5 notes JD.

money.en: A subsistence budget would be around 15 JD per day.
money.es: Un presupuesto de subsistencia sería de unos 15 JD por día.
money.quote: A subsistence budget would be around 15 JD per day

etiquette.en: Modest clothing should be worn at religious and old historical sites.
etiquette.es: Se debe usar ropa modesta en sitios religiosos e históricos antiguos.
etiquette.quote: modest clothing should be worn in religious and old historical sites.

etiquette.en: During Ramadan, avoid smoking, drinking, eating or chewing in public.
etiquette.es: Durante el Ramadán, evita fumar, beber, comer o masticar en público.
etiquette.quote: During Ramadan, you should avoid smoking, drinking, eating, or chewing in public.

etiquette.en: Do not photograph people without asking their permission.
etiquette.es: No fotografíes a personas sin pedirles permiso.
etiquette.quote: do not photograph people without asking their permission.

etiquette.en: Do not photograph police under any circumstances.
etiquette.es: No fotografíes a la policía bajo ninguna circunstancia.
etiquette.quote: Do not photograph police under any circumstances.

etiquette.en: Publicly criticising, shaming or insulting the Jordanian royal family is illegal.
etiquette.es: Criticar, avergonzar o insultar públicamente a la familia real jordana es ilegal.
etiquette.quote: it is illegal to publicly criticise, shame, or insult them.

etiquette.en: The text advises avoiding discussing Israel, as many Jordanians express strong negative feelings towards it.
etiquette.es: El texto aconseja evitar hablar de Israel, ya que muchos jordanos expresan fuertes sentimientos negativos hacia él.
etiquette.quote: Avoid discussing Israel. Like their counterparts in the Arab world, many Jordanians express feelings of hatred, anger, and bitterness towards Israel.

connectivity.en: WiFi is commonly available in restaurants, cafés, hostels and hotels.
connectivity.es: El WiFi suele estar disponible en restaurantes, cafés, hostales y hoteles.
connectivity.quote: WiFi is commonly available in restaurants, cafés, hostels and hotels.

connectivity.en: Temporary SIM numbers can be bought at the airport or any mobile shop for 5 JD.
connectivity.es: Se pueden comprar números temporales en el aeropuerto o en cualquier tienda de telefonía por 5 JD.
connectivity.quote: Card-based temporary numbers can be purchased at the airport or any mobile shop for 5 JD.

connectivity.en: Foreign travelers may be required to show a passport even to buy prepaid cards.
connectivity.es: A los viajeros extranjeros se les puede exigir el pasaporte incluso para comprar tarjetas prepago.
connectivity.quote: foreign travelers may be required to provide a passport, even for prepaid cards.

connectivity.en: Jordan has three mobile operators, Zain, Orange and Umniah.
connectivity.es: Jordania tiene tres operadores móviles: Zain, Orange y Umniah.

connectivity.en: Near Aqaba, GPS may show an incorrect location or none at all.
connectivity.es: Cerca de Aqaba, el GPS puede mostrar una ubicación incorrecta o ninguna.
connectivity.quote: be prepared for your GPS device to show an incorrect location or no location at all.
